pr_automation_id.description: The id of the PR automation to invoke.

context.description: A JSON-encoded string-valued map filling the PR automation configuration fields. Keys are configuration field names and values are the chosen inputs.

branch.description: The source branch name for the generated pull request. Use a concise, descriptive name and avoid existing branches.

identifier.description: Optional repository identifier override (for example owner/repo). Leave unset to use the automation default.
